- Suggest tightening the headline to: "Production LLM inference: predictable latency, lower unit cost" (keeps focus on latency + cost).

> Sub-head: Run open models across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments with centralized controls and per-route observability
- Maybe: "Run open models anywhere — hosted, dedicated, or private — with unified controls and per-route telemetry."

Bullets:
- "Deterministic latency at scale" -> "Deterministic latency for real-time apps" (makes audience explicit)
- "Cost controls: batching & cache policies" -> list examples: "Intelligent batching, KV cache, and quantization guidance"

CTA flow: my thinking is we surface both Start trial (primary) and Request PrivateOffer (secondary) on hero, but make PrivateOffer prominent in the pricing tile as well. For ACME (large enterprise) we should have an anchor "Request PrivateOffer" that opens a short intake form and attaches the term sheet.

Attachments: added a one-pager suggestion for the intake fields (I can share after this thread).

Small ask: Kimberly, can you confirm whether we can attach term-sheet.docx to PrivateOffer form or if AWS requires us to handle that in DocuSign?

-Ben
